name: land-change-qa-library
description: 2026 年第一期地类变化图斑表 标准问题库 + SQL/工具示例（依据浙江省2025年自然资源监测成果统计分析报告-问题参考模板扩充）
notes: 原土地类型 = DLBM/DLMC（三调二级类）；图斑类型（变化后） = TBLX（影像编码）
面积 MJ 单位平方米；耕地(原)=DLBM LIKE '01%'；耕地(现)=TBLX IN ('01','1')
TBLX→三大类映射以 skills/land-report/assets/tblx_categories.json 为准：
strategy=tool 表示优先调用确定性统计工具（SQL 由后端固化，更稳定）；
strategy=sql 表示用 run_sql 执行参考 SQL；每个条目均附参考 SQL 作为口径依据
耕地流出=原耕地(DLBM LIKE '01%')且现非耕地；耕地流入=原非耕地且现耕地(TBLX IN ('01','1'))；净变化=流入−流出（避免耕地→耕地重复计）
恢复性地类（流入耕地的来源）集合=园地(02%)+林地(03%)+坑塘水面(1104%，含 1104A 扩展码)，需业务确认
本轮依据《浙江省2025年自然资源监测成果统计分析报告-问题参考》模板扩充林地/草地/永农/红线/非粮化/建设用地结构/可调整地类等 14 条
新增口径字段：SFYN=是否涉及永农(是/否)；SFHX=是否涉及红线(是/否)；JSYDXZ=建设用地性质；ZZSXMC=种植属性；TZ=图斑特征；QSX=前时相；HSX=后时相；CZCSXM=城镇村属性
SFYN/SFHX 为预计算标记（非空间叠加），'违法/违规'需叠加审批数据；数据仅到县级行政区(90 县)，无乡镇/村级字段

entries.question: 全库共有多少个变化图斑、总面积是多少
entries.intent: 全库图斑总数与总面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse"
entries.answer_hint: 总数与总面积必须来自该汇总查询，勿把显示的分组相加

entries.question: 计算每种图斑类型的图斑数量和总面积
entries.intent: 按图斑类型（变化后 TBLX）汇总数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT t."TBLX", count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t GROUP BY t."TBLX" ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: “每种类型”默认指图斑类型（变化后）；完整明细由表格卡片展示，正文只做结论式总结

entries.question: 筛选出所有耕地图斑，统计其图斑数量和总面积
entries.intent: 变化前为耕地（原土地类型 DLBM 01%）的数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" LIKE '01%'
entries.answer_hint: 耕地无修饰时指原土地类型（DLBM 01%），需说明口径

entries.question: 统计变化后为耕地的图斑数量和总面积
entries.intent: 变化后为耕地（图斑类型 TBLX 01/1）的数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "TBLX" IN ('01','1')
entries.answer_hint: “变化后为耕地”指 TBLX='01'（数据可能含 '1' 写法）

entries.question: 耕地流出、流入与净变化是多少，流向哪里、从哪里来
entries.intent: 耕地前后流向确定性汇总（流出/流入/净变化 + 方向与来源构成）
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" LIKE '01%'
entries.answer_hint: 一次调用 farmland_flow_summary 即可；流向按三大类（前=三调，后=模糊映射）

entries.question: 原耕地流向建设用地的面积是多少
entries.intent: 原耕地(DLBM 01%) 且变化后为建设用地(TBLX∈建设模糊集) 的数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" LIKE '01%' AND "TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH')
entries.answer_hint: 建设用地代码集合以 tblx_categories.json 为准；也可用 construction_change_summary 的“其中原耕地”项

entries.question: 新增建设用地有多少，来自哪里、分布在哪些县
entries.intent: 新增建设用地（后时项 TBLX 模糊映射）汇总/分县/来源构成
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH')
entries.answer_hint: 一次调用 construction_change_summary 即可；分县表格默认取面积前 10

entries.question: 面积小于某阈值的细碎图斑有多少、占比多大
aliases: 面积小于X平方米的图斑
entries.intent: 面积(MJ)小于阈值的图斑数量与占全库数量/面积的比例
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "MJ" < 100
entries.answer_hint: 调用 fragment_stats(threshold_m2=X)；注意数据面积值域 50-200，阈值≤50 恒为 0

entries.question: 变化面积最大的转换类型有哪些（如耕地→建设用地）
entries.intent: 原一级类→现三大类（模糊映射）转换面积 Top-N
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(d."YJLMC",'其他') AS original, CASE WHEN t."TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH') THEN '建设用地' WHEN t."TBLX" IN ('01','02','03','04','ND','KT','SK','GQ') THEN '农用地' ELSE '其他' END AS current, count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t LEFT JOIN knowledge_base.dict_land_classification_summary d ON t."DLBM" = d."DLBM" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY area DESC LIMIT 10
entries.answer_hint: 一次调用 top_conversions(top_n=N) 即可

entries.question: 找出面积最大的单个图斑，说明其图斑类型和所在行政区
entries.intent: 按面积排序取单个最大图斑的明细
entries.sql: SELECT "OBJECTID", "XMC", "DLMC", "TBLX", "MJ" FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" ORDER BY "MJ" DESC, "OBJECTID" LIMIT 1
entries.answer_hint: Top-N 明细用 ORDER BY "MJ" DESC, "OBJECTID" LIMIT N

entries.question: 按面积从大到小排序所有建设用地图斑，显示前 10 条
entries.intent: 原三调建设用地图斑按面积 Top-10 明细
entries.sql: SELECT "OBJECTID", "XMC", "DLMC", "TBLX", "MJ" FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" ~ '^(05|06|07|08|09|100[1-5]|100[7-9]|1109|1201)' ORDER BY "MJ" DESC, "OBJECTID" LIMIT 10
entries.answer_hint: 建设用地无修饰指原三调建设用地（canonical 正则过滤）

entries.question: 计算建设用地占总面积的百分比
entries.intent: 原三调建设用地面积占全库面积的百分比
entries.sql: SELECT sum("MJ") AS jsyd_area_m2, (SELECT sum("MJ") FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse") AS total_area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" ~ '^(05|06|07|08|09|100[1-5]|100[7-9]|1109|1201)'
entries.answer_hint: 百分比只引用查询结果列，禁止用手算

entries.question: 分区县统计变化图斑数量和总面积
entries.intent: 按县级行政区(XMC)汇总图斑数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT "XMC" AS region, count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" GROUP BY "XMC" ORDER BY area DESC
entries.answer_hint: 可用 construction_change_summary 的分县表获得“新增建设用地分县”

entries.question: 列出所有地类名称和对应的地类编码
entries.intent: 查询合并地类字典的原二级类编码/名称清单
entries.sql: SELECT "DLBM", "DLMC" FROM knowledge_base.dict_land_classification_summary ORDER BY "DLBM"
entries.answer_hint: 地类名称/编码来自字典表，禁止凭空编造

entries.question: 列出所有图斑类型（TBLX）的名称和编码
entries.intent: 查询图斑类型字典(TBLX 编码→名称)清单
entries.sql: SELECT "TBLX", "TBLX_CODE" FROM knowledge_base.dict_tblx ORDER BY "TBLX"
entries.answer_hint: TBLX 名称必须 JOIN dict_tblx（前导零：数据 01-04 对应字典 1-4）

entries.question: 将面积单位从平方米换算为公顷和亩（或反过来）
entries.intent: 面积单位换算（平方米↔公顷↔亩）
entries.answer_hint: 调用 convert_area(value=..., from_unit=...)；1公顷=10000㎡、1亩=2000/3㎡≈666.6667㎡；给整列生成新面积列时用 run_sql 乘以上述系数

entries.question: 统计每个行政区的耕地总面积
entries.intent: 按县级行政区(XMC)汇总耕地（原 DLBM 01%）面积（数据仅到县级，无乡镇字段）
entries.sql: SELECT "XMC" AS region, count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" LIKE '01%' GROUP BY "XMC" ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: 数据只有县级行政区(XZQDM/XMC)，无乡镇/村级字段：问“乡镇”时说明仅能到县级，按 XMC 分组

entries.question: 计算每种地类的总流出面积、总流入面积和净变化面积
entries.intent: 全地类（三大类层面）流出/流入/净变化转移矩阵
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(o."category", i."category") AS "category", COALESCE(o.outflow_m2, 0) AS outflow_m2, COALESCE(i.inflow_m2, 0) AS inflow_m2, COALESCE(i.inflow_m2, 0) - COALESCE(o.outflow_m2, 0) AS net_m2 FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN d."CATEGORY_NAME" IS NOT NULL THEN d."CATEGORY_NAME" WHEN t."DLBM" ~ '^(05|06|07|08|09|100[1-5]|100[7-9]|1109|1201)' THEN '建设用地' WHEN t."DLBM" LIKE '%K' OR t."DLBM" IN ('1104A','1107A','1208') THEN '农用地' ELSE '其他' END AS "category", sum(t."MJ") AS outflow_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t LEFT JOIN knowledge_base.dict_land_classification_summary d ON t."DLBM" = d."DLBM" GROUP BY 1) o FULL JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN t."TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH') THEN '建设用地' WHEN t."TBLX" IN ('01','02','03','04','1','2','3','4','ND','KT','SK','GQ') THEN '农用地' WHEN t."TBLX" IN ('SM','HL','LT','LY','WH','QT') THEN '未利用地' ELSE '其他' END AS "category", sum(t."MJ") AS inflow_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t GROUP BY 1) i ON o."category" = i."category" ORDER BY "category"
entries.answer_hint: 前(原)走三调映射、后(现)走 TBLX 模糊映射，统一到三大类才可比；净变化=流入−流出；全表均为变化图斑，流出按原地类、流入按现地类各计一次

entries.question: 计算建设用地的来源构成（分别来自哪些地类，各占多少比例）
aliases: 新增建设用地来自哪些地类
entries.intent: 新增建设用地（后时项 TBLX）的来源（原一级类）构成与占比
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(d."YJLMC", t."DLMC", '其他') AS source_type, count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2, round((sum(t."MJ") * 100.0 / (SELECT sum("MJ") FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH')))::numeric, 2) AS share_pct FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t LEFT JOIN knowledge_base.dict_land_classification_summary d ON t."DLBM" = d."DLBM" WHERE t."TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH') GROUP BY COALESCE(d."YJLMC", t."DLMC", '其他') ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: 来源按原一级类(YJLMC，如耕地/林地/园地)，占比=该来源面积/新增建设用地总面积×100；如需二级类明细把 YJLMC 换成 DLMC

entries.question: 耕地流入分别来源于哪些地类，各是多少（园地、林地、建设用地、坑塘水面等）
entries.intent: 现耕地（变化后为耕地）的原地类来源构成（按一级类细分）
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(d."YJLMC",'其他') AS source_type, count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t LEFT JOIN knowledge_base.dict_land_classification_summary d ON t."DLBM" = d."DLBM" WHERE t."TBLX" IN ('01','1') AND t."DLBM" NOT LIKE '01%' GROUP BY COALESCE(d."YJLMC",'其他') ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: 来源=原地类一级类(YJLMC：园地/林地/草地/湿地/交通运输用地/水域及水利设施用地/其他土地/商服/工矿/住宅等)；建设用地=商服+工矿+住宅+公共管理与公共服务+特殊+交通运输各一级类之和；坑塘水面=水域及水利设施用地下的二级类(见 farmland_inflow_recoverable)

entries.question: 耕地流入中来源于建设用地的面积是多少
entries.intent: 现耕地(TBLX 01/1)且原为建设用地(三调建设 regex)的面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t WHERE t."TBLX" IN ('01','1') AND t."DLBM" ~ '^(05|06|07|08|09|100[1-5]|100[7-9]|1109|1201)'
entries.answer_hint: 方向与 farmland_to_construction 相反（那是耕地→建设，这是建设→耕地）；建设用地=原三调建设 regex，现耕地=TBLX IN ('01','1')

entries.question: 由恢复性地类（种植园地、林地、坑塘等）流入耕地的面积是多少
aliases: 园地林地坑塘转为耕地
entries.intent: 现耕地(TBLX 01/1)且原为恢复性地类(园地/林地/坑塘水面)的面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t WHERE t."TBLX" IN ('01','1') AND (t."DLBM" LIKE '02%' OR t."DLBM" LIKE '03%' OR t."DLBM" LIKE '1104%')
entries.answer_hint: 恢复性地类集合=园地(02%)+林地(03%)+坑塘水面(1104%，含 1104A 扩展码)，口径需业务确认；若字典口径不同以 dict_land_classification_summary 为准

entries.question: 分县统计耕地流出、流入与净变化，找出净减少最多（或净增加最多）的县
entries.intent: 按县级行政区(XMC)汇总耕地流出/流入/净变化并按净变化排序
entries.sql: SELECT "XMC" AS region, sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" LIKE '01%' AND "TBLX" NOT IN ('01','1') THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" NOT LIKE '01%' AND "TBLX" IN ('01','1') THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" NOT LIKE '01%' AND "TBLX" IN ('01','1') THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" LIKE '01%' AND "TBLX" NOT IN ('01','1') THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS net_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" GROUP BY "XMC" ORDER BY net_m2 ASC
entries.answer_hint: 净减少县=net_m2<0 的行(数量即这类行数)；净减少最多=第一行；净增加最多=末行；净减少Top10=前10行；数据仅到县级无乡镇字段；亩=㎡/666.67

entries.question: 林地流出、流入与净变化是多少，流向哪里、从哪里来
entries.intent: 林地（原 DLBM 03% / 现 TBLX 03）前后流向汇总（流出/流入/净变化）
entries.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" LIKE '03%' AND "TBLX" <> '03' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "TBLX"='03' AND "DLBM" NOT LIKE '03%' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "TBLX"='03' AND "DLBM" NOT LIKE '03%' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" LIKE '03%' AND "TBLX" <> '03' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS net_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse"
entries.answer_hint: 林地流出=原林地(03%)且现非林地；流入=现林地(TBLX=03)且原非林地；净变化=流入−流出；报告用亩时按 1亩≈666.67㎡ 换算

entries.question: 草地流出、流入与净变化是多少
entries.intent: 草地（原 DLBM 04% / 现 TBLX 04）前后流向汇总
entries.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" LIKE '04%' AND "TBLX" <> '04' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "TBLX"='04' AND "DLBM" NOT LIKE '04%' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "TBLX"='04' AND "DLBM" NOT LIKE '04%' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN "DLBM" LIKE '04%' AND "TBLX" <> '04' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS net_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse"
entries.answer_hint: 草地流出=原草地(04%)且现非草地；流入=现草地(TBLX=04)且原非草地；净变化=流入−流出

entries.question: 永久基本农田（永农）范围内耕地流入、流出与净变化是多少
aliases: 永久基本农田耕地净变化
entries.intent: 涉及永久基本农田（SFYN=是）图斑的耕地流入/流出/净变化
entries.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN "SFYN"='是' AND "DLBM" LIKE '01%' AND "TBLX" <> '01' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "SFYN"='是' AND "TBLX"='01' AND "DLBM" NOT LIKE '01%' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_m2, sum(CASE WHEN "SFYN"='是' AND "TBLX"='01' AND "DLBM" NOT LIKE '01%' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN "SFYN"='是' AND "DLBM" LIKE '01%' AND "TBLX" <> '01' THEN "MJ" ELSE 0 END) AS net_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse"
entries.answer_hint: SFYN='是'为预计算的'是否涉及永农'标记（非空间叠加）；可加 GROUP BY "XMC" 做分县排名

entries.question: 耕地流出分别流向哪些地类，各是多少
entries.intent: 耕地（原 DLBM 01%）流出后变化为的图斑类型明细（按 TBLX 中文名）
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(d."TBLX_CODE", t."TBLX") AS target, count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t LEFT JOIN knowledge_base.dict_tblx d ON t."TBLX" = d."TBLX" OR t."TBLX" = '0'||d."TBLX" WHERE t."DLBM" LIKE '01%' AND t."TBLX" <> '01' GROUP BY COALESCE(d."TBLX_CODE", t."TBLX") ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: 对应模板附录'耕地流出情况统计表'；目标类型用 dict_tblx 中文名（动土/林地/建/构筑物/园地/在建道路/硬化/水面等）

entries.question: 林地流出分别流向哪些地类，各是多少
entries.intent: 林地（原 DLBM 03%）流出后变化为的图斑类型明细
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(d."TBLX_CODE", t."TBLX") AS target, count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t LEFT JOIN knowledge_base.dict_tblx d ON t."TBLX" = d."TBLX" OR t."TBLX" = '0'||d."TBLX" WHERE t."DLBM" LIKE '03%' AND t."TBLX" <> '03' GROUP BY COALESCE(d."TBLX_CODE", t."TBLX") ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: 对应模板附录'林地流出情况统计表'（耕地/园地/草地/水面/建设用地/交通运输用地/水利设施用地等）

entries.question: 新增建设用地的结构构成是怎样的（按建设用地性质分类）
aliases: 新增建设用地性质构成
entries.intent: 新增建设用地（TBLX∈建设集）按建设用地性质(JSYDXZ)的结构构成
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE("JSYDXZ",'未分类') AS structure, count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH') GROUP BY COALESCE("JSYDXZ",'未分类') ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: JSYDXZ 值：公共服务/住宅用地/工业用地/商业用地/交通场站/特殊用地/水利设施，约 87% 图斑为空('未分类')；如需建设用地/交通运输/水利设施三大类拆分，改按原 DLBM 一级类(YJLMC)聚合

entries.question: 可调整地类流向建设用地的面积是多少
aliases: 可调整地类流向建设用地
即可恢复工程恢复转建设用地
entries.intent: 种植属性为'即可恢复/工程恢复'的图斑流向建设用地（TBLX∈建设集）的数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "ZZSXMC" IN ('即可恢复','工程恢复') AND "TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH')
entries.answer_hint: 对应模板'可调整地类流出/流向建设用地'；可调整地类=种植属性 ZZSXMC ∈ {即可恢复, 工程恢复}

entries.question: 耕地的种植属性构成是怎样的（粮食/非粮/轮作/未耕种等），非粮化面积多少
entries.intent: 耕地（原 DLBM 01%）按种植属性(ZZSXMC)分类统计，识别'非粮化'规模
entries.sql: SELECT "ZZSXMC" AS planting_attr, count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" LIKE '01%' GROUP BY "ZZSXMC" ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: 种植属性值：种植粮食作物/种植非粮食作物/粮与非粮轮作/即可恢复/工程恢复/未耕种；'非粮化'=种植非粮食作物+粮与非粮轮作两项之和

entries.question: 生态保护红线范围内的地类变化情况如何，是否存在疑似转为建设用地
entries.intent: 涉及生态保护红线（SFHX=是）图斑的类型构成，并识别疑似建设
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(d."TBLX_CODE", t."TBLX") AS type, count(*) AS n, sum(t."MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" t LEFT JOIN knowledge_base.dict_tblx d ON t."TBLX" = d."TBLX" OR t."TBLX"='0'||d."TBLX" WHERE t."SFHX"='是' GROUP BY COALESCE(d."TBLX_CODE", t."TBLX") ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: SFHX='是'为预计算的'是否涉及红线'标记（非空间叠加）；其中 TBLX∈建设集的行即红线内疑似新增建设，需结合审批数据判定是否违规

entries.question: 永久基本农田范围内疑似转为建设用地的图斑有多少、面积多大
aliases: 违规占用永久基本农田
entries.intent: 涉及永农(SFYN=是)且现为建设用地/疑似建设(TBLX∈建设集)的图斑数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "SFYN"='是' AND "TBLX" IN ('20','YH','DT','TD','DL1','DL2','DL3','TL','SJ','CK','YT','WL','TP','GF','LD','JC','ZQC','GEF','TH')
entries.answer_hint: 本库只能给出'疑似占用永农'（SFYN=是 且 TBLX∈建设集），是否'违法'需叠加农转用/供地等审批数据；可加 GROUP BY "XMC" 得到分县分布

entries.question: 林地转为耕地的图斑有多少、面积多大，分布在哪些县
entries.intent: 原林地(DLBM 03%)且现耕地(TBLX 01)的图斑数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" WHERE "DLBM" LIKE '03%' AND "TBLX" = '01'
entries.answer_hint: 林地→耕地（与退耕还林反向）；如需分县分布改为 SELECT "XMC", count(*), sum("MJ") ... GROUP BY "XMC" ORDER BY 3 DESC

entries.question: 按图斑特征(TZ)统计各特征的图斑数量和面积
entries.intent: 按图斑特征(TZ)汇总数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE("TZ",'未分类') AS feature, count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" GROUP BY COALESCE("TZ",'未分类') ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: TZ=图斑特征，约 93% 图斑为空('未分类')，其余为 ZZ/GY/SN 及数字编码；语义需字段字典 metadata_column 或业务确认

entries.question: 按前时相、后时相统计各时段的变化图斑数量和面积
entries.intent: 按前时相(QSX)/后时相(HSX)组合统计变化图斑数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT "QSX" AS qian_shixiang, "HSX" AS hou_shixiang, count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" GROUP BY "QSX","HSX" ORDER BY area_m2 DESC LIMIT 20
entries.answer_hint: QSX=前时相(2025-08~10 影像日期)、HSX=后时相(2026-03~06)；用于判断变化发生时段，报告期次口径需业务确认

entries.question: 按城镇村属性(城镇/村庄等)统计变化图斑的数量和面积
entries.intent: 按城镇村属性码(CZCSXM)汇总数量与面积
entries.sql: SELECT COALESCE("CZCSXM",'空') AS chengzhencun, count(*) AS n, sum("MJ") AS area_m2 FROM data."2026_1_change_landuse" GROUP BY COALESCE("CZCSXM",'空') ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
entries.answer_hint: CZCSXM=城镇村属性码(201城镇/202村庄/203-205 及 A 变体)，约 83% 图斑为空，仅对有值的建设类图斑有意义
